source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fairly little specific pin site care actually being needed for a client who has this kind of stabilizing device in place","B":"Regular pin site cleaning per protocol and monitoring for signs of infection or loosening, given the direct communication between the pins and the skull","C":"Allowing the pin sites to remain completely untouched and uncleaned for an indefinite period of time following placement","D":"Care essentially identical to routine skin care performed elsewhere on the body, without any special attention paid to the pins"}}
source_row.rationale: Halo traction pin site care includes regular cleaning per protocol and ongoing monitoring for signs of infection or pin loosening, given the direct communication between the pins and the skull, an important consideration for this device used to stabilize serious cervical spine injuries.
